no_target.title: No DNS server selected
no_target.message: No target server was chosen and TECHNITIUM_API_URL is not configured.
no_target.action: Add a server using the switcher in the top bar.

blocked_target.title: Target rejected by the security policy
blocked_target.message: That address is in a dangerous range (cloud metadata, multicast or reserved) or is not on the allowlist.
blocked_target.action: Check the server address, or adjust TECHNITIUM_ALLOWED_TARGETS.

endpoint_not_found.title: Unknown API endpoint
endpoint_not_found.message: The requested path is not in the endpoint registry.
endpoint_not_found.action: Reload the page. If it persists, the server version may not match.

method_not_allowed.title: Method not supported
method_not_allowed.message: That endpoint does not accept the HTTP method used.
method_not_allowed.action: Reload the page and try again.

missing_token.title: Not signed in
missing_token.message: This action needs a valid token, and none is stored on this device.

proxy_error.title: Proxy error
proxy_error.message: The local proxy failed while handling the request.
proxy_error.action: Check the server-side logs for details.

invalid_token.title: Session expired
invalid_token.message: The token is invalid or has expired.

two_factor_required.title: Two-factor code required
two_factor_required.message: This account has two-factor authentication enabled.
two_factor_required.action: Enter the code from your authenticator app.

upstream_error.title: The server returned an error
upstream_error.message: The DNS server rejected the request.
upstream_error.action: Check that the parameters you entered are valid.

bad_upstream_response.title: Unexpected upstream response
bad_upstream_response.message: The DNS server replied with something that could not be parsed.
bad_upstream_response.action: The endpoint's response shape may differ from what is expected. Try again.

upstream_unreachable.title: Cannot reach the DNS server
upstream_unreachable.message: The host did not respond, or its name failed to resolve.
upstream_unreachable.action: Confirm the server is running and reachable from this machine.

upstream_timeout.title: Request timed out
upstream_timeout.message: The DNS server did not answer within the time limit.
upstream_timeout.action: Try again later. Exports and backups can take a while.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.message: The request failed without further detail.

http.403: You are not allowed to perform this action
http.404: The requested resource does not exist

ui.title: Something went wrong
ui.reportHint: Copy the details below when reporting the problem.
ui.notFoundBody: The page you requested does not exist.
ui.serverErrorBody: An unexpected error occurred while rendering this page.

validation.invalidDomainName: “{value}” is not a valid domain name
validation.invalidIpAddress: “{value}” is not a valid IP address
validation.invalidCidr: “{value}” is not a valid CIDR range
validation.invalidTtl: TTL must be a positive integer
validation.invalidMacAddress: “{value}” is not a valid MAC address
validation.invalidSerial: Serial number must be a positive integer
